title: Project Charter
description: Scope, timeline & baseline budget for a delivered project. Matches public.project_charters, with public.project_charter_objectives embedded as `objectives` and the public.project_charter_funding join table (charterId, procurementItemId composite PK, no other columns) surfaced as `fundingProcurementItemIds`.

purchaseOrderId.description: FK -> procurement-plan/purchase-order.id. Nullable -- on_delete set null (migration 0054). Wires this Charter to Procurement: linking a PO pulls its ntpDate into startDate immediately (trigger), and keeps following it if the PO's ntpDate changes later.

startDate.description: Auto-follows the linked Purchase Order's ntpDate once purchaseOrderId is set (migration 0054, trigger-maintained). A normal manually-entered field otherwise -- not readOnly, since a Charter can exist before procurement even starts.

overallProgressPercent.description: Trigger-maintained (migration 0022): (Milestones with status = Completed) / (total Milestones) x 100. Count-based, not weighted -- milestones.weight exists but isn't used by this formula. Read-only.

fundingProcurementItemIds.description: Backed by the public.project_charter_funding join table -- Procurement Items that fund this charter.
